fichas.title: Poultry Housing and Chicken Coop
fichas.summary: Poultry housing should be clean, airy, dry, draught-free, insulated, weatherproof, and designed for cleaning. The page describes scratching and sleeping rooms, laying nests, perches, ventilation, a chicken coop for 20 chickens, and a coop with a run. It recommends placing the window south and the door east, with laying nests in a dark location away from windows.
uses: Providing outdoor access and a sand bath
